site.name: FLOW Presenter
site.motto: FREE SOFTWARE. BUILT TO SERVE. SUPPORTED BY KINDNESS.
site.meta_description: FLOW Presenter is free church presentation software by JPHON, built to help churches, ministries and media teams serve with confidence.

home.hero_subtitle: Helping churches experience better presentation and media production, one ministry at a time.
home.hero_description: FLOW Presenter is a free presentation software created to help churches and ministries improve their worship services and media production without the expensive cost of professional presentation software.
home.hero_story:
Behind this project is a personal journey. I created FLOW Presenter not only because I wanted to build something useful, but also because I wanted to help churches that may not have the resources to afford expensive presentation software.

If FLOW Presenter has been helpful to you or your church, you may consider supporting me through a voluntary donation to help with my ongoing hospital bills and the continued development of this project.
home.hero_note: Free to download. Free to use. Donations are completely voluntary.
home.about_title: MORE THAN JUST A PRESENTATION SOFTWARE.
home.about_text:
FLOW Presenter was created with one simple purpose: to make quality church presentation tools more accessible to churches and ministries.

We understand that not every church has the budget to purchase expensive presentation software. Yet every church deserves tools that can help its media team serve effectively.

That is why FLOW Presenter was developed as a free alternative, designed around the practical needs of church presentation teams.

highlights.title: MADE FOR CHURCHES
highlights.text: Designed with church worship services, lyrics presentation, Bible verses, and media teams in mind.

highlights.title: SIMPLE TO USE
highlights.text: A practical interface that helps volunteers and media operators manage presentations more efficiently.

highlights.title: FREE FOR EVERYONE
highlights.text: No subscription fees or required payments. The goal is to make useful presentation tools accessible.

mission.mission: To provide accessible and practical presentation software that empowers churches and ministries to improve their worship services, communicate God's Word clearly, and serve their congregations through technology.
mission.vision: To see more churches and ministries equipped with useful and accessible media production tools, regardless of their financial capacity.

values.title: Accessibility
values.text: Quality tools should not be limited to churches with large budgets.

values.title: Service
values.text: Technology should be used to support and serve others.

values.title: Simplicity
values.text: Software should be practical and easy for volunteers to learn.

values.title: Community
values.text: Development should grow through feedback, suggestions, and collaboration.

support.title: HELP KEEP THIS PROJECT GOING.
support.text:
FLOW Presenter is offered free of charge. Developing and maintaining software takes time, effort, and resources.

If this software has helped your church or media team, you can help me continue this journey through a voluntary donation.

Your generosity will also help me with my ongoing hospital expenses.

Whether big or small, every contribution is sincerely appreciated.
support.note: No donation is required. FLOW Presenter will remain free to use.

download.macos_note: A macOS version of FLOW Presenter is coming soon.
download.requirements:
Windows 10 (version 1809 or newer) or Windows 11, 64-bit
64-bit (x64) dual-core processor
4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended for HD/4K video)
About 400 MB of free disk space
Screen resolution of 1280 × 720 or higher
A second display or projector for presenting (recommended)
download.install_steps:
Download the installer using the button above.
Open the downloaded file to start the setup.
Follow the steps in the installer.
Open FLOW Presenter from your Start menu or desktop shortcut.

about.title: THE STORY BEHIND FLOW PRESENTER.
about.intro: FLOW Presenter was created out of a desire to build practical software for churches that cannot afford expensive presentation solutions.
about.story:
FLOW Presenter started as a personal project: a way to put my skills in software and media production to use for the church.

Along the way, it also became part of my own journey, including the ongoing hospital expenses I am facing today. Sharing it for free is my way of serving while I keep building.
about.why: Many church media teams are made up of volunteers working with limited budgets. Professional presentation software can be expensive, and that cost should not stand between a church and a clear, well-run worship service.
about.problems:
High subscription and licence costs for small churches.
Complicated tools that are hard for new volunteers to learn.
Media teams having to piece together several programs for one service.
about.philosophy: Keep it practical, keep it simple, and keep it free. Every update is guided by what real church media teams need on a Sunday, and by the feedback of the people who use it.
about.future: Continue improving stability and ease of use, publish more tutorials, and grow FLOW Presenter together with the churches and media teams who use it.
about.developer_text:
FLOW Presenter is an independent software project developed under JPHON. It is continuously being improved through learning, experimentation, feedback, and the support of its community.

This is not a perfect software, and there is always room to improve. If you discover a bug, have a suggestion, or want to request a feature, I would be happy to hear from you.

donate.title: YOUR SUPPORT MAKES A DIFFERENCE.
donate.subtitle: Help me continue creating free software for churches while supporting me through my ongoing hospital expenses.
donate.message:
First of all, thank you for taking the time to visit this page.

FLOW Presenter was created because I wanted to help churches and ministries experience better media production without having to spend a lot of money on expensive software.

I decided to share this software for free because I believe useful tools should be accessible to those who need them.

Behind this project, however, is a personal journey. I am also dealing with ongoing hospital expenses, and maintaining and developing this software requires time, effort, and resources.

If you have found FLOW Presenter useful, and if you are willing and able, I would sincerely appreciate any voluntary donation.

Your support will help me with my hospital bills and encourage me to continue developing free software that can benefit more churches and ministries.

Thank you for your kindness, prayers, encouragement, and support.
donate.thanks: Every contribution, every prayer, and every word of encouragement means a lot. Thank you for being part of this journey.
